title: David Sun - Expectancy Hacking (S5E5)
summary:
We're a quantitative investment in research firm dedicated to helping investors proactively navigate the risks of investing through more holistic diversification. Focused on selling options to capture the volatility risk premium, David believes that
markets are ultimately efficient and therefore foregoes using any sort of active
signal. We discuss this approach in both theory and practice, addressing
issues such as trading costs and slippage drag, as well as both sequence
sequence and event risk.

thesis: The guest argues that markets are ultimately efficient and therefore foregoes using any active signal. Instead, he focuses on explicitly controlling his win size relative to his loss size and choosing a strategy with a win rate that bumps him into positive expectancy.
